en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Al Ahmasy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! He will not be saved from the sins except the one who acknowledges with it’.
He (the narrator) said, ‘And Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The regret suffices as a repentance’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu‘Umayr from Ali al- Ahmasi from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:
“Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said, ‘By Allah no one escapes sins except those who confess it.’
The narrator has said that abu Ja’far (a.s.) then said, ‘Repenting is enough proof of one’s being regretful.’”
